Films 'The Odyssey' and 'Dhamaal 4' See Box Office Performance

Christopher Nolan's film 'The Odyssey' earned $264.1 million globally in its opening weekend, with $124.5 million domestically. In India, the film reportedly collected ₹61 crore over its opening weekend, with some reports claiming it crossed ₹2150 crore in budget recovery within two days. Meanwhile, the film 'Dhamaal 4' reportedly breached the ₹100 crore mark in India by its eighth or ninth day, with its tenth-day collection showing a significant jump.
